property_summary: For every call to C.transfer with a non-empty _tos, the reference always returns true (completes successfully) when every external transferFrom call to the callee succeeds and reverts when any such external call fails; the mutant inverts the success check so it returns true when the external call fails and reverts when it succeeds, which will cause differing completion behavior for inputs where the callee can be made to fail.
change_summary: Invert the success check of the external call so the function returns true when the call fails and reverts when it succeeds, altering returned result for inputs where the call returns false.
